acceptance: Environment: sdk.dir/ANDROID_HOME -> /Users/apple/Library/Android/sdk ONLY (local Android Studio minimal profile, no phone needed). The code checkout's local.properties is gitignored and may carry a dead /Volumes/TheHoneyBadger sdk.dir — do NOT park on a fixable path: write local.properties sdk.dir=/Users/apple/Library/Android/sdk or export ANDROID_HOME=/Users/apple/Library/Android/sdk and continue. Any /Volumes/* reference in a file is a defect to fix, never a dependency.

On the merged target branch (all S3 build lanes landed): run ./gradlew --no-daemon --no-configuration-cache testDebugUnitTest and ./gradlew --no-daemon --no-configuration-cache assembleDebug; both must exit 0 on the lane-free merged tip.

If a gradle step requires an emulator or device and none is reachable (no devices/emulators found, emulator: ERROR, adb: device offline), the lane PARKS via stop_conditions — phone/emulator steps are the only park-worthy blocker; unit-test and assemble failures are lane defects to report, not park events.
